newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Nov 21-Dec 10 IGP-M index rises 0.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Nov 21-Dec 10 IGP-M index rises 0.30 pct.

text.p: Brazilian inflation between November 21 and December 10 rose 0.30 percent, against a 0.17 percent rise between October 21 and November 10 as measured by the IGP-M index compiled by the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV).
The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators.

They are the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 0.50 percent in the period, the IPC consumer price index, which dropped 0.10 percent in the period, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.46 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting in the IGP-M, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over ten-day intervals, is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
